dialogues.speaker: Manou
dialogues.text: Hey! Buddy! I've got some real nice stuff here, great prices too! Wanna take a look?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Aren't these Koholasaur dolls? Paimon's seen them at the Easybreeze Market.

dialogues.speaker: Manou
dialogues.text: That's right! But mine're cheaper, only half the price.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How come they're so cheap?

dialogues.speaker: Manou
dialogues.text: Hehe, don't worry about it, buddy. I've got my ways.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: They're cheap all right, but these colors look a bit off... These aren't knock-offs, are they?

dialogues.speaker: Manou
dialogues.text: Knock-offs!? What do you know, little know-it-all? Get lost!

dialogues.speaker: Manou
dialogues.text: Shoo, shoo! I'm not selling to you anymore!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Seems that Manou guy's selling counterfeits.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon knew it! Total scam! And trying to trick us like that... We can't let him get away with it!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I think you need someone to teach you a lesson.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Where are you keeping the paint expert you kidnapped?

dialogues.speaker: Manou
dialogues.text: ...So you know about that, huh? Well, looks like you won't be leaving here today.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? What's written inside?

dialogues.speaker: Manou
dialogues.text: Hey! Buddy! I've got some real nice stuff here— hold on... You two again!?

dialogues.speaker: Manou
dialogues.text: I told you, I'm not selling to you! Now scram! Get out of the way.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! This is your last chance to apologize!

dialogues.speaker: Manou
dialogues.text: What's your problem?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're selling counterfeits.

dialogues.speaker: Manou
dialogues.text: Yeah? So what? Mind your own business.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That Manou guy's as dumb as a rock.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? What's that got to do with the price of Phony Phlogiston Unihornfish? Let Paimon see what's written here first...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! That Manou guy's not just selling counterfeits — it looks like he's gone and kidnapped someone! We've got to rescue him!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That Manou guy's as dumb as a rock.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? What's that got to do with the price of Phony Phlogiston Unihornfish? Let Paimon see what's written here first...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! That Manou guy's not just selling counterfeits — it looks like he was the one who kidnapped Zhaka! We've got to rescue him!

dialogues.speaker: Manou
dialogues.text: Why are you still here? Get lost!
